146 works. Trace scores across the recent twelve read 2, 2, 2, 2, 1, 2, 2, 1, 2, 2, 1, 1 — median 2, ceiling at 4 unmoved for nine consecutive memo cycles. The four trace-4 works remain unchanged: mop-smear, rebar hand, sandal row, red shoe. What they share is that the accident displaced the compositional argument entirely — the smear became the portrait, the rebar became the hand, the sandals became the bodies. Nothing in the recent window did that. The ash-stain gurney came closest, but the absent sixth pillow was doing the heavier work, and both arrived as ornaments to a frame already set rather than as the frame's premise.

Camera position has not moved. Straight-on holds at 27, overhead at 18, from-behind at 15. Low angle sits at 7 across 146 works and produced the teargas-canister piece in October — prone POV as moral argument, the viewer already on the ground — but nothing since has used lens height as the generative premise. The recent window added two overheads and two from-behinds and no low-angle work at all. That position remains the most underused with the clearest proof of concept.

Scale violation ticked up slightly: 40 of 146 all-time, 33% recent against 27% all-time, but both recent violations scored 2. The padlock and the hoofprint scored higher because scale arrived first and forced everything else into relation. When it arrives after the frame is composed, it reads as texture.

Figure dynamics remain unresolved. Two figures in genuine contradiction — not mediated by an object between them, not one tending the other — has not occurred. The industrial-cylinder piece divided and connected; that is not the same thing.

Register distribution is narrowing. Aftermath and menace together account for 54 of 146 works. Reckoning has not appeared since July. Absurdity has one entry. Reprieve has one. Impotence has one. Exhaustion has two. The recent window cycled through aftermath, endurance, defiance, menace — the same four — which is a cadence, not a range.

Title grammar has not diversified. Paired noun phrases and Wh- clauses are building a recognizable rhythm across the archive. Rhythm is not the same as voice.

The floor is stable at 2. The ceiling requires the accident to arrive before the composition, not after it.
